items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Well one side is Nat Shilkrest... Yeah, I made that one.

ctx.x: Yeah, there's good musicians there. Would you want to hear, I'd rather be the girl in your arms, or you want to play something else? There's one thing I want you to play.

There's one thing I want you to play. Here's, this got me puzzled here. Well one side is Nat Shilkrest. Well, no it's not Nat Shilkrest. Nat Shilkrest, yeah that's right. Me and my shadow. This one here I'm going to meet my sweetie. Nah. Yeah, I made that one. But I heard that on the other record.
It's on the LP too, yes, that's right.
